info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Intellectual Property Portfolio Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of intellectual property portfolios, allowing organizations to efficiently create and organize their knowledge assets. The service provides capabilities to submit new intellectual property entries and manage existing records, which can benefit businesses engaged in innovation and technology. Typical consumers include legal teams and product development departments that require robust asset tracking and reporting functionalities. By utilizing this API, users can streamline their intellectual property processes and enhance their competitive edge.

post.summary: Create a new intellectual property portfolio.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new intellectual property portfolio, enabling them to manage various IP assets efficiently. The portfolio can contain multiple types of intellectual properties, such as patents, trademarks, and copyrights, consolidating them in one place for better oversight and strategic planning.
